ja154:1.1: Here amongst the snakes the noble one has entered,
ja154:1.2: (Being) a rock with colour, desiring safety.
ja154:1.3: Paying homage to the holy man of high class,
ja154:1.4: (Though) hungry, I overcame (the desire) to eat.
ja154:2.1: Guarded by Brahmā, may you live for a long time,
ja154:2.2: And may divine food manifest itself to you.
ja154:2.3: Whoever, honouring the holy man of class,
ja154:2.4: (Though) hungry, you overcame (the desire) to eat.
